description: Approval of the Livent Transaction Agreement Proposal: Adopt the Transaction Agreement, dated as of May 10, 2023, as amended by the Amendment to Transaction Agreement, dated as of August 2, 2023 and the Second Amendment to Transaction Agreement, dated as of November 5, 2023 (and as it may be further amended from time to time, the "Transaction Agreement"), among Livent, Allkem Limited, Arcadium Lithium plc (f/k/a Allkem Livent plc, f/k/a Lightning-A Limited) ("NewCo") and Lightning-A Merger Sub, Inc. ("Merger Sub"), pursuant to which, among other transactions, Merger Sub will merge with and into Livent, with Livent surviving the merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of NewCo (the "merger"), and each share of Livent common stock, par value $0.001 per share, other than certain excluded shares, will be converted into the right to receive 2.406 ordinary shares, par value $1.00 per share, of NewCo (the "NewCo Shares"), and approve the transactions contemplated by the Transaction Agreement, including the merger (collectively, the "Transaction") (Proposal 1).
